i.norm: Characters that lie outside the Base16 alphabet (0-9, A-F): '/' (47) and ':' (58) bracket the digit range 0-9 (48-57) '@' (64) and 'G' (71) bracket the uppercase hex letter range A-F (65-70) '%' (37) is an unrelated special character '`' (96) and 'g' (103) bracket the lowercase letter range a-f (97-102), which is invalid for the default upper-case Base16 codec
